title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm out and about with Kawakami Princess…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I follow her gaze and see a claw machine filled with Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No thanks. I'm not interested in that kind of thing at all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It wouldn't be very elegant of a princess to get obsessed with a claw machine.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Besides which, it's impossible to grab a plushie with such a weak claw! IMPOSSIBLE, I tell you!
choice_data_list: I take it you've failed at this before.
I take it you've failed at this before.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, let's just forget it. That weak little baby claw's not gonna—
choice_data_list: Even small amounts of strength can be useful.
Even small amounts of strength can be useful.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah! Now that you mention it, in Princess Fighter episode twenty-six, they say, "Don't be deceived by the size of a crab's claw!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "When used the right way, even the smallest pinch can capture a massive whale!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please show me the strength of that tiny crab!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
